name: code.review
description: Cheap broad screen over a whole codebase or a large diff. Produces the shortlist a System 2 model then reads.

dead_code.instructions: This code is unreachable, unused, or superseded

duplicate_logic.instructions: This duplicates logic that plainly belongs in one place

magic_values.instructions: This relies on unexplained magic numbers or string literals

name_lies.instructions: The function or variable name does not describe what it actually does, including its side effects

comment_useless.instructions: The comment restates the code rather than explaining intent, constraint, or a non-obvious why

error_swallowed.instructions: An error or failure path is swallowed, so a failure would read as success

severity.instructions: How much does this actually matter
criteria: Will cause a real defect or incident

rules.reason: a swallowed failure reads as success -- the worst class of bug in this codebase
high-severity finding, route to a System 2 agent
name does not describe side effects
